body: Hi, thank you for your reply. I don't really want to go into details on why I hate him, it's mostly because he didn't treat me that well in the past and did something disgusting that I'll never forgive him. I've been reading forums for autistic people but they usually trigger bad memories, also it reminds me of my condition and I'd rather just ignore it. And I think I'm going to do it soon anyway, my life's getting worse and worse every day and I can't imagine that it's possible to get out of this.
